programs.description: A father's world revolves around his five daughters as he raises them with a lot of love. However, he wonders if they will receive the same care when they get married and move in with their in-laws.
Nidhi, a fearless and kind-hearted young woman, marries her soulmate Gowtham. However, soon she finds herself in the middle of family conspiracies aimed at tearing them apart.
Nandini, a devoted village girl, crosses paths with Surya, whose resentment toward his mother drives him to pursue a relationship with her.
Once martyred in the line of duty, a constable's position is inherited by his incorruptible daughter. However, soon, she encounters the benevolent enforcer of a notorious criminal.
The life of the members of two families who are busy in their own lives, gets connected to each other due to an unfortunate incident.
Being the sole breadwinner of her family, Bhavana, a nurse, works hard and sacrifices her needs to support her mother and siblings.
